gotchas: Several of these have a REMOTE PANEL port that is not a data bus: PROwatt SW remote panel, TRUEcharge2 remote panel, TRUEcharge3 remote panel, Freedom X remote panel (RJ12, PN 808-0817), Solar MPPT remote panel (710-0010). Proprietary, undocumented, and driving one is a reverse-engineering project, not an integration.

Freedom X and Freedom XC are listed here as no-comms ON THEIR OWN. Add a Freedom X Combox (808-0822 / -01) and they become RV-C or NMEA 2000 devices — see xantrex-rv-c-unknown. The inverter alone has no bus.
Freedom X Bluetooth Remote Panel exists and pairs with a phone app, but no BLE service/characteristic documentation is published, so it is not a protocol the catalogue can act on.

The Xantrex brand today is Xantrex LLC, part of Mission Critical Electronics / Power Products LLC, and the line is aimed at RV, marine, and work trucks. The legacy off-grid residential line (XW, Conext SW, MPPT 60-150 / 80-600, C-series controllers, Trace SW) went to Schneider Electric and is no longer sold under the X

docs/catalog/no-comms.md already carries two Xantrex entries from an earlier sweep — a 1000 W 12 V mobile inverter (used-market, Montreal) and a regulated DC bench supply. Neither is contradicted by anything here; the existing note that 'Xantrex's comms-capable lines (Freedom, XW) are a different matter' is now backed
